### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/Patricked-code/MCP/blob/eb2aff8ef30ed349cc8d477cb23e7e364ae088df/scripts/program-backlog-convergence-lib.mjs#L86-L87 **![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat) Enforce dependencies for manually activated blueprints** When a gated blueprint is manually moved from `CONDITIONAL`/`DEFERRED` to `READY`, its `autoPromotable` flag remains `false`, so this condition keeps it `guarded` and preserves `READY` even if `incompleteDependencies` is nonempty. `program:next` will then offer the blueprint for execution before its prerequisites are `DONE`, contrary to the required dependency-safe selection loop; guarding should prevent automatic gate promotion without bypassing dependency validation after manual activation. AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L56-L60](https://github.com/Patricked-code/MCP/blob/eb2aff8ef30ed349cc8d477cb23e7e364ae088df/AGENTS.md#L56-L60)
